title: Enqueue discovered files to the raw-files queue

user_story.i_want: each newly discovered file sent to the raw-files queue
user_story.so_that: workers can process files in parallel

description: Build a `RawFileMessage` (STR-105) per new ledger row and send with SendMessageBatch in chunks of 10 (the SQS limit). Successful entries mark the row `queued`. A failed entry is retried once, otherwise the row stays `discovered` for reconciliation (STR-604). Put the queue client behind a small trait so it can be faked in tests.

acceptance_criteria.then: 3 batch calls (10, 10, 3) are made, 23 messages are on the queue and 23 rows are queued

acceptance_criteria.given: a fake queue reporting 2 failed entries

acceptance_criteria.then: it is a valid RawFileMessage matching docs/architecture.md

rust_concepts: A trait as a testing seam
